title.zh: 重新设立新比斯开省 Imugan 市镇区并将其名称改为 Santa Fe 的法案
title.en: An Act to Recreate the Municipal District of Imugan, Province of Nueva Vizcaya, Which Name is to be Changed to Santa Fe
title.orig: An Act to Recreate the Municipal District of Imugan, Province of Nueva Vizcaya, Which Name is to be Changed to Santa Fe

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 6 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1959/ra_2179_1959.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The Municipal District of Imugan in the Province of Nueva Vizcaya is hereby recreated.

The boundaries existing between said Municipal District of Imugan and the towns of Aritao and Kayapa before the effectivity of Executive Order Numbered Three hundred sixty-eight, series of nineteen hundred fifty, are hereby restored.
The name of Imugan is hereby changed to Santa Fe.
The seat of the municipal government shall be located in Santa Fe.
The officials of the recreated municipal district shall be appointed by the President of the Philippines.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: May 2, 1959.
